page.title: Chat
page.description: The unified operator chat - merged, live Twitch and YouTube chat across your connected accounts. For connector diagnostics, see Engagement.

moderationAction.messageDeletedNotRetained: A message was deleted (no longer retained)

deletionReason.userMessagesCleared: Removed when this user's messages were cleared

status.gapWarning: Some messages may have been missed (the stream reconnected or fell behind). What follows is current, but not guaranteed complete.
status.busGapWarning: Some events were missed before this projection started listening. History before this point may be incomplete.

compose.placeholder: Send a message as the connected account…
compose.sharedChatWarning: Twitch may distribute this message across every channel in a Shared Chat session - this application cannot restrict it to a single channel.
compose.permissionRequired: Outbound chat permission has not been granted for this account yet.
compose.authorizeStarted: Authorization started - enter code {{userCode}} on Twitch to finish.
compose.unsupported: This provider does not support sending chat messages yet.
compose.backendUnavailable: The chat backend is unavailable right now.
compose.rateLimitedUntil: Sending is temporarily rate limited - try again after {{time}}.
compose.noLocalEchoExplanation: This message will send, but no local echo will appear here until inbound chat is enabled for this account.
compose.deliveryUnknown: This message may or may not have been delivered - no confirmation was received.
compose.forbidden: This send was rejected - the account may be banned or timed out in this chat room.
compose.providerFailure: An error occurred while sending this message.
compose.queueFull: Too many messages are already queued for this account - wait a moment and try again.
